note: Baseline: first working prompt. One Choice per decision over code-generated candidates.
rules: You are playing Balatro, a poker roguelike. Each round you must reach the blind's chip target before running out of hands. A played hand scores (chips) x (mult); jokers modify the score. Discards cost no hand but are limited. Money buys jokers, packs and vouchers in the shop; holding money earns interest ($1 per $5 held, up to $5).

instructions.blind: Should we play or skip the upcoming blind?
instructions.move: Choose the best next move this round. Weigh playing now against discarding to build a stronger hand, given the chips still needed, hands left, discards left, and how the jokers boost each hand type.
instructions.shop: We are in the shop. What is the single best next shop action to maximise the chance of winning the run?
instructions.pack: A booster pack is open. Which card should we take, if any?

options.blind_play: Play the {name} (need {score} chips) and earn its cash reward
options.blind_skip: Skip the {name} to gain the {tag_name}: {tag_effect}. Skipping forgoes the blind's money and shop visit.
options.play: Play {hand} scoring {scoring}{kicked}. Estimated {estimate} chips before jokers; {need} still needed.
options.discard: Discard: {label}. Throws away {cards} and draws replacements.
options.shop_leave: Leave the shop and go to the next blind, keeping the money
options.shop_reroll: Reroll the shop for ${cost} to see new cards
options.shop_sell_joker: Sell joker {item} for ${sell} to free a slot
options.pack_skip: Skip the rest of this pack (listed first)
